WIT Reintroduces TransJel Red and TransJel Gold Assembly Lubricants

August 25, 2026
12 Views
1 Min Read
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 1:13
Instaread

SHEPHERDSVILLE, KY — August 19, 2026 — Whatever It Takes Transmission Parts, Inc. (WIT) is pleased to announce the return of TransJel Red and TransJel Gold Assembly Lubricants, giving transmission professionals access to proven assembly lubricants designed for transmission component assembly.

Both products are currently in production and will be available soon. Customers can contact their WIT sales representative to learn more about availability.

Designed with oil-based technology, TransJel lubricants provide lubrication during assembly while helping hold components in place. Both formulations are designed to mix completely with transmission fluid without changing fluid viscosity or operational characteristics.

TransJel Red (Part No. M465WTJ) features a light-tack consistency, while TransJel Gold (Part No. M465WTJG) provides a medium-tack consistency and is designed for applications where a neutral color is preferred. Both can be used with components including bearings, gaskets and seals and are designed for filterability across transmission applications.

“Customers have been asking us to bring TransJel back, and we’re excited that WIT has been able to deliver,” said Rodney Peters, President and CEO of Whatever It Takes Transmission Parts, Inc. “We’re proud to once again offer TransJel Red and TransJel Gold to transmission professionals who have relied on these products for years.”
